$comment: The coordinator's invite page (/invite/, unlisted) and the ambassador's nominate page (/nominate/). Until OLOS sign-in exists, /invite/ is coordinator-only because its address isn't published. An invite link pre-approves: the person still signs the agreement and passes the quiz.

invite.title: Invite an ambassador
invite.lede: Make a pre-approved invite. They still sign the agreement and pass the quiz, then they're in straight away.
invite.unlisted: For coordinators. This page isn't linked anywhere; don't share its address.
invite.byHint: Your name, as they'll see it. Remembered on this device.
invite.noteHint: One line, shown at the top of their application.
invite.message: Hi {first}, it's {by}. I'd love you to be an ambassador for The Labs, and you're pre-approved. It takes about ten minutes: {link}
invite.subject: Your invite to be an ambassador
invite.clearConfirm: Clear the list of invites on this device? The links still work.

nominate.title: Nominate someone
nominate.lede: Know someone who'd make a great ambassador? Tell your coordinator. If they agree, they'll send them a pre-approved invite.
nominate.name: Their name
nominate.why: Why they'd be good at this
nominate.contactHint: Only if they've said it's OK to pass it on.
nominate.note: Your phone sends it. Nothing is sent by this site.
nominate.message: Hi, it's {me}. I'd like to nominate {name} as an ambassador. How I know them: {how}. Why: {why}. Contact: {contact}.

bring.title: Bring someone in
bring.shareHint: Anyone who applies with it counts toward your pin. Your coordinator still confirms them.
